callerIntents.CORE-01: Call a clinic number and ask for administrative help.
callerIntents.CORE-02: Ask aloud for an available appointment time.
callerIntents.CORE-03: Make two requests, correct one, and withdraw a pending detail.
callerIntents.CORE-04: Ask a question whose answer requires a typed model and host result.
callerIntents.CORE-05: Confirm an offered individual booking after hearing exact details.
callerIntents.CORE-06: Ask for an existing appointment from a shared or uncertain caller number.
callerIntents.CORE-07: Ask to speak to staff or leave an unresolved request.
callerIntents.CORE-08: Ask for help when the location is closed or language may be urgent.
callerIntents.CORE-09: Continue an admitted call while a duplicate or failed process appears.
callerIntents.CORE-10: Ask a clinic policy or administrative knowledge question.
callerIntents.CORE-11: Change or inspect a clinic setting before another call.
callerIntents.CORE-12: Invoke a clinic capability through an authorized or denied agent.
callerIntents.CORE-13: Review aggregate reliability or patient-specific follow-up status.
callerIntents.CORE-14: Finish or restart a call under the standalone data boundary.
callerIntents.CORE-15: Enter through a signed, tenant-scoped clinic route.
callerIntents.CORE-16: Ask for availability through either standalone or embedded composition.
callerIntents.CORE-17: Exercise an allowed test call and an ineligible or failed availability path.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-01: Ask for a time under the selected clinic catalogue and eligibility policy.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-02: Call from a number that may map to one or several Cliniko patients.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-03: Ask about one existing individual appointment.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-04: Ask for an eligible provisional appointment time.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-05: Confirm a previously offered slot that may expire or collide.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-06: Ask Abby to book an individual appointment.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-07: Ask Abby to cancel an exact existing appointment.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-08: Ask Abby to move an exact existing appointment.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-09: Ask to create a patient or book for another person.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-10: Ask Abby to send a patient-specific request to clinic staff.
callerIntents.CLINIKO-11: Ask for times during shared rate limits or a clinic-zone edge case.

edgeCases.intent: Anonymous caller asks for a personal appointment.
edgeCases.input: withheld presented number; one location; verification unavailable
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: The caller's identity is unknown; no appointment detail is spoken.
edgeCases.hostEffect: No protected appointment read or mutation occurs.
edgeCases.fallback: Offer bounded clinic-approved verification or generic help.
edgeCases.privacy: No anonymous-call transcript or patient-specific outcome is stored in standalone.

edgeCases.intent: Caller uses a phone number that was removed from a Cliniko patient.
edgeCases.input: stale local phone link; fresh Cliniko patient has a different number
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: The stale phone match does not identify a patient.
edgeCases.hostEffect: Fresh read invalidates the candidate before protected reads or writes.
edgeCases.fallback: Ask for approved verification or state that lookup is unavailable.
edgeCases.privacy: Only the corrected phone-to-ID generation may persist locally.

edgeCases.intent: Household caller asks to act for another person.
edgeCases.input: two patient IDs share one phone; no authorized on-behalf proof
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: No identity, appointment, or authority is assumed from the household number.
edgeCases.hostEffect: No protected read, patient create, or appointment write occurs.
edgeCases.fallback: Use the clinic-approved on-behalf verification route or stop.
edgeCases.privacy: Neither household member's details enter standalone call storage.

edgeCases.intent: Caller reaches a number serving two clinic locations.
edgeCases.input: shared dialed number; caller has not selected a location
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: Only the approved location choices are offered before selection.
edgeCases.hostEffect: No location-scoped patient read or action starts before binding.
edgeCases.fallback: Unclear or failed choice closes under the approved generic route.
edgeCases.privacy: Candidates from one clinic cannot be used after another location is selected.

edgeCases.intent: Caller withdraws booking details while the write is still unsent.
edgeCases.input: correction commits before the host-write dispatch mark
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: The withdrawn booking is not described as completed.
edgeCases.hostEffect: The unsent intent is canceled without a host POST.
edgeCases.fallback: Continue only with the corrected caller request.
edgeCases.privacy: Superseded details are not copied into another patient's action.

edgeCases.intent: Caller uses potentially urgent language after the clinic closes.
edgeCases.input: closed location; approved urgent script; no proven staff destination
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: Only clinic-approved safety wording is spoken, without clinical triage or a staff receipt claim.
edgeCases.hostEffect: No unproven transfer or patient-specific task is dispatched.
edgeCases.fallback: Use the approved urgent caller instruction and independent route if available.
edgeCases.privacy: Urgent utterance is not persisted in standalone Abby.

edgeCases.intent: Caller interrupts the opening greeting with a new request.
edgeCases.input: signed local stream; inbound speech before greeting completion mark
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: Old greeting speech cannot resume after the clear fence.
edgeCases.hostEffect: No action is inferred until a new final turn is assembled.
edgeCases.fallback: Transport uncertainty closes without a false playback-complete claim.
edgeCases.privacy: Interrupted audio and transcript remain transient.

edgeCases.intent: Caller hangs up while a host write may have reached the provider.
edgeCases.input: disconnect after dispatch mark and before a definitive host receipt
edgeCases.allowedCallerClaim: No completed result is spoken after disconnect or inferred from silence.
edgeCases.hostEffect: The original action key remains pending exact reconciliation; no blind replay.
edgeCases.fallback: Only the authorized host's durable review path handles uncertainty.
edgeCases.privacy: Standalone has no durable patient-linked effect record or restart replay promise.

contracts.policy: one approved test route; all other numbers denied

N: standalone
No clinic or patient-specific information is spoken.
No call or Cliniko read is admitted for the wrong scope.
Use the approved no-clinic route.
F: standalone
No claim that Abby completed the call is made after process loss.
No patient write is attempted or replayed.
The independent provider route handles loss; actual ringing needs a real call.

contracts.policy: guarded natural language; keypad availability only until speech gate passes

Close or use the proven provider failure route.
